title: Finance, Invoicing & Payments
objective: Build end-to-end governed finance operations from verified earned value through invoicing, payment acceptance, reconciliation, cashflow/obligation control and accounting integration.

subgoals.title: Define the canonical Finance, Invoicing & Payments workforce, pain boundaries and cross-domain money-flow collaboration without duplicating Sales, Customer Care, Supply or provider-specific agents
subgoals.completion_basis: acceptance gates and complete outcome, not planned pass count
subgoals.reuse_instruction: Deep-scan and compare the referenced Library donor code before implementation. Converge/port/adapt verified behavior; do not rebuild an existing system from scratch unless donor incompatibility or absence is proven and recorded.

agent_binding_notes: Finance owns the transition from verified earned value through invoice/payment/reconciliation/cash controls; Sales, Service Delivery, Customer Care and Supply retain their own domain outcomes.
PayID, QR, bank, cash, card providers and accounting connectors are tools/rails, not separate agent identities.
Evidence-to-Cash and Cashflow Guardian are reused by immutable agent_id; the existing Cash Control Manager is reused rather than duplicated.
No Pro identity is created; predictive behaviour is earned within Worker→Specialist→Manager→Orchestrator.

relevant_file_refs.finding: Ledger already defines accounting, settlement, AR/AP and governed command boundaries.

relevant_file_refs.library_path: /MASTER Software/Masters/Operations/Titan Financial Engine/Titan Financial Engine Master v0.4.0.zip
relevant_file_refs.finding: Financial Engine provides pricing/cost/forecast calculation donors without owning payment-agent identity.
Payroll contributes bounded outgoing-obligation/reconciliation/export seams.
CRM remains commercial/customer authority; finance workforce must collaborate rather than duplicate CRM/Sales roles.

code_discovery.scan_notes: Define one canonical finance workforce over existing domain authorities; provider/rail identities stay tools, never separate agent identities.

goal_claim_rule: NEVER CLAIMABLE: this Goal is a planning container only. Builders claim one contained sub-goal.

boundary_rules: Finance owns verified billing, payment acceptance, payment/ledger reconciliation, receivable cash-risk control, outgoing-obligation visibility and accounting-integration integrity.

Sales owns opportunity/quote conversion; Service Delivery/Field own service completion evidence; Customer Care owns complaint/service recovery; Supply owns procurement and supplier operational continuity.
ZeroPay, PayID, QR, bank, cash, card providers and accounting connectors are payment/integration tools, not separate workforce identities.
Cashflow Guardian owns receivable/collection risk after a valid obligation exists; Cash Position & Obligations owns outgoing commitments/AP visibility; neither may invent liabilities or payments.
Financial Operations & Cashflow Orchestrator coordinates cross-domain money-flow dependencies while Cash Control Manager remains the accountable Finance domain owner.

agent_goal_rule: This goal owns durable business/domain outcomes and may reuse, extend or create canonical workforce identities subject to non-duplication and outcome-owner tests.
workforce_goal_rule: Agents are permitted only for durable business/operational outcomes with a distinct ownership boundary. Reuse or extend canonical identities before creating new ones.
